Results.ReviewText: This little grill is absolutely amazing, and perfect for me, and my husband.
Results.Title: Totally Perfect!!

Results.ReviewText: pretty good bbq/grill for camping, rv's, and  smaller decks
Results.Title: big fan

Results.ReviewText: Easy set-up, temperature control simple and accurate, cooks evenly.
Results.Title: Great portable grill

Results.ReviewText: I had a serious issue with a grill fire coming from the exact model I just purchased. Weber said they would either send parts to replace the burned grill or a refund check. I have not got the check and did not want to rebuild the original grill. I very much like the grill I just want them to follow through on their resolution. I own 6 Weber grills and I am a loyal customer. The fire was serious and I needed to use a full size fire extinguisher to put it out
Results.Title: Please resolve the complaint

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Q1200 gas grill for my apartment balcony.  It is just the right size and can easily handle steaks for four people.  Had a slight problem fitting the first canister - but persevered with the instruction booklet and can now see where I was going wrong!
Results.Title: Perfect size for apartment balcony

Results.ReviewText:
Grill was easy to assemble and works very well.
Cooks evenly and the grease drains well into the removable tray
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Perfect unit for our RV and at home.  Grills steaks to perfection.
Results.Title: Great portable grill

Results.ReviewText: After a ton of research and considering a strong recommendation from our son we bought this Q. Out of the box we were impressed with the quality of materials and design. Most of our grilling is for the 2 of us so the size is more than adequate. It has a high dome if that's necessary and has an enameled grill. It comes up to full temperature quickly. We've only used it a few times but we're impressed. It folds closed easily and stores in the garage. A year down the road I may have more info, but so far this grill is a winner. Should the need arise it is uber portable and will run off a small bottle or using a large tank with an adapter hose while at home.
Results.Title: Perfect size and features

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic grill for 2-3 people does everything the larger Weber grills do but in a much smaller space.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: My new grill, Cherry, was bought to replace my old 120 that was rammed by a front-end loader. The old one was great. I expect Cherry to be the same!
Results.Title: Cherry

Results.ReviewText: I love my new 1200 for its a great grill for the table top bbq'er and its compact too!  Easy to travel with and a breeze to set up. Heck, you don't even need a table, really 😂. I have only had my 1200 for a month and I am not the only member of our family with a 1200!  I am very happy with the way it cooks and , as you do lose a bit of heat if you stockpile 10 chicken thighs at once 😂. Trying a couple less next time!!!
Results.Title: Convenient piece of equipment!!!

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill. We love it for just my husband and I! This is the second one we have purchased. Great buy!!!
Results.Title: Terrific Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for the occasional griller and very easy to clean. The fact that the grates are in two pieces allows me to soak and clean easily.
Results.Title: Perfect size

Results.ReviewText:
Last summer, my wife gave me a BBQ for my birthday (the best gift for me), but the most important thing was that it was a Weber. She knew I wanted a Weber, and I had also been searching for the best option. I had been happy until three weeks ago.

I was cleaning my Weber and getting it ready for spring, but it didn’t work. I tested to find the problem and discovered it was the valve. I contacted customer service, and after a week and a half, I received the replacement part. I switched the valve, and my smile came back!

Thanks! Now I just need to buy a t-shirt that says, 'Every day is grill day!'"**
Let me know if you'd like any further tweaks!
Results.Title: Weber don't disappoint me!!

Results.ReviewText:
Love this grill… Easy to clean, cooks perfectly.
I've cooked Bratwurst, steaks, Carne Asada and chicken… stoked that I picked this grill.
Results.Title: You definitely get what you pay for

Results.ReviewText: Love the little guy. It is perfect for my wife and I and occasionally our daughter. Gets way hotter than previous bigger grill and it is easier to move around and clean.
Results.Title: Perfect Grill for Us

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. So sorry to learn your grill flame is blowing out. This is very unusual. We want to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from our Care team soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Major problem: We are in southern FL where it is sunny and windy by the lake at our resort. When the wind hits about 5 -7 mph, it blows out the flame on the burner. VERY inconvenient and frustrating.
Results.Title: WIND VS GRILL = NO FLAME

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill.  Very easy out of box assembly.  This grill heats up quickly and food taste great.  We have been using our Weber Q2000 for years at home and when camping.  Decided to give that one to my son and get a more compact one to take with us camping.  The Q1200 is perfect.
Results.Title: Q1200 a perfect grill purchase

Results.ReviewText:
Q1200 is the little grill that works like a larger grill. It’s small and works well for camping, grilling in tight spaces and or tailgating.  It cooks evenly and provides a great grilling experience.  I purchased this one to replace the same that was close to 9 years old. Not a lot to these little beasts.  Attach the propane cylinder, turn dial
To ignite and light the battery powered igniter .
Heats up quite and grilling is a breeze!
Results.Title: Purchased to replace a 9 year old of same model.

Results.ReviewText: This is an awesome little grill. Just my husband and I so this is a perfect size. It lights up easily and gets hot quickly. Cooks nice and evenly. I love this little grill!!
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: Great quality iron and very well thought functionalities: the grill is cut in half for easier placement and removal, fat is collected at the bottom after grilling and the burners are protected by design from becoming greasy. A little small so only recommended for single or 2 people use. The electric lighter does not look very durable, we will see.
Results.Title: Good value for money, very functional, small

Results.ReviewText: Purchased after getting burnt by a gas grill. Feel much safer! Just used it one time so far, did a good job cooking Steak on it. Easy clean up was nice, easily remove drip pan and wash it in kitchen sink. It would be easier if it had a ridge on end to pull it up with?
Results.Title: Nice alternative to Gas Grill for RV

Results.ReviewText: Have a small patio and this grill is the perfect size...  good size cooking space, and heats up so quickly.
Results.Title: Mighty but compact

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Q-grill, so that says I recommend them - especially nice for singles and couples, who don't need a large grill. I am a bit sorry that these are now set up to use the small propane cylinders, instead of the 5-gallon refillables that my previous one was fitted for - that results in extra expense and more frequent replacements.
Results.Title: Second Q purchase

Results.ReviewText: Nice little BBQ. Went from the traditional large on wheels with huge grill and haven't been sorry. Lights easily, nice heavy grills, and nice that it has a temp gauge on it - most s,ma;ll;er units don't.
Results.Title: Downsized and happy!

Results.ReviewText: This is our 2nd Webber 1200.  We have had one at home for about 8 years and we just bought another for camping in our RV.  Very easy to set up.  Cooks evenly and is great for travelling as it doesn’t take up a lot of room.
Results.Title: Webber 1200

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. So sorry to hear you keep having an issue with the valve and regulator. Our team wants to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: gas regulator has failed 3 times needing replacement, Expensive part to keep failing
Results.Title: gas regulator fails frequently

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill.  I've owned a couple of Weber Q grills starting with the original about 20 years ago.  I like the portability, it gets hot quick and the coated cast iron grates leave nice grill marks and food doesn't stick.  The electronic ignition and lid thermometer are nice upgrades from the original model.
Results.Title: Love It!

Results.ReviewText: So far it is a great grill. We love it. Perfect size for us. Very easy to set up and use. Cooks and cleans well also. Very satisfied as a first time weber owner.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: Works as I expected it to……. Great!  I have owned the Weber 1000 and the 2200. The 1200 is perfect for my RV.
Results.Title: Another Winner!

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback regarding the Q1200. So sorry to hear about your experience with the gas regulator. We want to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Not at all happy with my Q1200 grill gas regulator
Results.Title: Bad regulator

Results.ReviewText: Perfect grill for my RV.  It folds up to a small size.  It heats up to 400 very fast.  The grill height allows for roasting a large chicken.
Results.Title: Perfect small size for RV travel

Results.ReviewText: Bought this lil Weber at Lowe's at a big discount price. Love It!
Results.Title: Thrillin Grillin

Results.ReviewText: Cook top is even across the whole grill. I haven't had a problem with hot spots. My only complaint is the gas bottle connection is a little clumsy.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. Small in size but very versatile. Perfect for tailgates and even quick lunches. Hard to beat
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I have seen many of these being used for tailgating at the football games I go to. So I decided to get one for myself.
Results.Title: Tailgate grill

Results.ReviewText: Such a wonderful easy to assembly very durable grill. I got red and its very pretty. It all cleans easily and it grills excellent. Love having the temp on there too.
Results.Title: Excellent portable grill

Results.ReviewText: Love these little bbq’s, efficient and carry a big punch, great for getting that high sear fast. This guy heats up fast and can surprisingly hold a lot on the grill, like a good 6-8 strip-loins. Buy this once and it’ll last you forever. Sides fold up and comes with a great cover, electric ignition and runs on the small green propane tanks but with an adapter can run on a 20pounder. Webber is the best in this category.
Results.Title: Amazing and small but big on performance

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. Your satisfaction is very important to us. So sorry to hear you are having an issue with your Q1200 grill. Our Care team wants to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: The grill only lasted two years. My mom probably only used it four or five times. It says it has a five year warranty, but the website doesn’t work and you can’t get anybody on the phone to help you. Don’t buy it
Results.Title: Weber grill 1200 Q

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to start ,cook on and clean. Appears to be well made and hopefully a long life
Results.Title: great grill

Results.ReviewText: this is my4th Weber grill in 55 years , I wont buy anything else
Results.Title: great little camp grill

Results.ReviewText: It’s my 4th bbq by Weber. After about a year or so I started getting low flame and I couldn’t pinpoint the problem after thinking it was propane supply related or dirty tube but was actually the regulator. Didnt expect that and hope it’s an uncommon issue.
Results.Title: Regulator fail

Results.ReviewText: Great gas grill for the money. Does what it is supposed to do!
Results.Title: Weber Q Grill
